notes.title: Launch sale is over. Thank you all!
notes.content:
With the launch week of Utopia Process officially over, I really wanted to start by saying [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who bought, played, wishlisted, or even glanced at Utopia Process.  It kept my soul in my body during 2020 and let me share something that I hope ya'll find interesting, warts and all. 

[b]Now about those warts...[/b]

The most common issue I've seen players deal with this week has been difficulty reading smaller text.  I'm going to update the colors of small text for higher visibility within the next two weeks.  Thank you to everyone who has let me know.

For bigger changes, I will be waiting until June.  There are some quality of life changes that have been eating at me that I want to get implemented before the Summer Sale. While I don't want to over promise, I'm looking at a few different things I can add.  I've divided them into definites and maybes:

[b]Definitely:[/b]
[list]
[*]Better tutorial text
[*]Expanded score tracking
[/list]
[b]Maybe:[/b]
[list]
[*]Extra music
[*]Online leaderboards
[*]Remixed enemy behavior
[*]Extra Modes
[/list]

Once again, if it's in the "maybe" list, do not treat it as a promise.  I'm looking into it and I have to try and fit these in between a day job and work on other games.  

Once again THANK YOU SO MUCH for all the support during the launch of my first game and keep an eye out for future sale prices and updates.

-Jo
